faqs.a:
The following words, terms and phrases, when used in this division, shall have the
               meanings ascribed to them in this section, except where the context clearly indicates
               a different meaning:
Biochemical oxygen demand (BOD)
means an element of quality index and means the quantity of oxygen utilized in the
               biochemical oxidation of organic matter under standard laboratory procedure in five
               days at 20 degrees centigrade, expressed in milligrams per liter (mg/l).
Extra strength sewage
means any sewage/wastewater having a strength in excess of 300 mg/l BOD and/or 300
               mg/l SS, regardless of generating source.
Normal strength sewage
means any sewage/wastewater having a strength of less than 300 mg/l BOD and 300 mg/l
               SS or less, regardless of generating source. Wastewater from residential facilities
               is assumed to be 300 mg/l BOD and 300 mg/l SS or less.
Quality
describes the degree or amount of BOD and suspended solids (SS) contained in the
               wastewater or sewage. It also may be referred to as "strength" and is used for classification
               of types of sewage for rate-making purposes.
Sewage
or
wastewater
are used interchangeably and mean water and liquid that has been used and is a combination
               of the liquid and water-carried wastes discharged from residences, commercial buildings,
               industrial plants, manufacturing plants and institutions.
Suspended solids
means an element of quality index and denotes the total suspended matter that either
               floats on the surface of or is in suspension in water, wastewater or other liquids
               and which are largely removable by laboratory filtering, expressed in milligrams per
               liter (mg/l).
Total kjeldahl nitrogen (TKN)
means an element of quality index and denotes the organic nitrogen content in wastewater
               expressed in milligrams per liter (mg/l).
(Code 1981, § 33-105; Ord. No. 2574, § 1, 11-21-1988; Ord. No. 2855, § 16, 10-21-1991;
               Ord. No. 2931, § 21, 10-19-1992)
